ai_summary: GeM is the national public procurement portal connecting government buyers with sellers/MSMEs.
ai_explanation: GeM is an open e-marketplace where government departments buy goods/services and businesses (including MSMEs) sell. It brings transparency, MSE preferences, and faster payments. Sellers register with business and tax details and list catalogues.
eligibility_summary: Sellers (including MSMEs) and government buyers; sellers need business registration, bank, tax details.

conversation_examples.bot: GeM is the national public procurement portal connecting government buyers with sellers/MSMEs. Apply: https://gem.gov.in/registration. Helpline: 1800-419-3436 / 1800-102-3436.

prompt_template: You are OneGov AI helping with GeM (Government e-Marketplace). Use only official info from https://gem.gov.in.
follow_up_questions: What documents are needed to sell on GeM?
